correctness.rationale: The polar Pfaffian a01*a23+a02*a13+a03*a12 gives 448 geometrically smooth binary quadrics; 56 polar two-planes and 16² quadratic refinements yield 14336 all-smooth pencils. Exact projective orbit traversal under elementary transvections gives the full five-orbit partition 560+3360+5040+5040+336; smooth-base representatives are (192,357) and (192,358) with 2 and 4 F2 points. Geometric smoothness uses Jacobian-minor unit ideals in each affine chart, rather than only rational smoothness. Hasse bound excludes the zero- and six-point other orbits. Frobenius t=3-#E gives traces ±1 and zeta numerators 1∓T+2T². Independently enumerated all 20160 invertible binary 4x4 coordinate matrices and verified four-element stabilizers: element orders [1,2,2,2] and [1,2,4,4], yielding V4 and C4, so those extra computations are sound.
residual_risks: Exhaustiveness of eight geometric Jacobian charts is asserted through exact symbolic unit ideals, not merely rational evaluation; retained source checker supplies certificate.
